name: Score Job Qualification - Baserow Prompt - Structured Output
description: Scores a job description against the master CV so multiple job-entry workflows share one qualification decision mechanism. Inputs are job_description (string), master_cv (object), and job_context (object); output preserves the context and adds qualification_score, should_apply, qualification_scoring_json, and prompt_usage.

parameters.content:
### Shared qualification scoring

Typed inputs: `job_description` (string), `master_cv` (object), and `job_context` (object). The workflow reads the active `qualification_scoring` prompt from Baserow, runs Gemini with fallback and auto-fixed structured output, and returns the original context plus the score and apply decision.
